title: Portable Agentic Workbench: carry safety contracts across hosts
audience: Teams that maintain agent workflows across hosts and need installs, projections, and recovery to stay explicit.
promise: Take one public workflow from manifest to dry-run, project it into two supported targets, and recover only the receipt-owned files without hiding the provider edge.
story: The public safe-tool-guards manifest names two allowlisted contract files and keeps dependencies empty.
Generic and Codex dry-runs preview the same two copies without mutating either empty target root.
Apply receipts, overwrite refusal, matching hashes, and receipt-scoped recovery make the local safety boundary inspectable.
The runtime comparison stops honestly: host behavior and provider-backed execution remain outside the repository policy.
verified_locally: The manifest-backed safe-tool-guards selection passes catalog, skills, and safety validation.
Generic and Codex dry-runs report two allowlisted copies with zero post-preview mutations.
Apply, overwrite refusal, matching projection hashes, manual-review visibility, and receipt-scoped recovery are recorded for both targets.
Modified receipt-owned content blocks recovery while an unrelated sentinel remains protected.
The 1600x900 preview is rendered from the same case and visually inspected.
open_gates: Provide a permitted executable host runtime or an approved offline adapter for PW-4 equivalence checks.
Verify a hosted no-auth case URL and external destination readbacks.
Keep browser capture and video optional follow-ons rather than prerequisites.
claim_boundary: This packet proves a local manifest, install, projection, and recovery contract. It does not claim equivalent agent decisions, host registration, provider execution, production quality, hosted access, or publication.
